propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy type-specific shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contract requirements, allowing padded plans to pass without Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated in two files (_engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py), creating maintenance drift risk when extending deterministic checks.

Plan-writing guidance and formal plan-review criteria documentation diverge on Success Criteria (author guide requests it; authoritative G6 does not) and rejected-alternative prose (author guide requires it; G6 explicitly forbids), creating conflicting signal to authors.

Deterministic checks for section shape, AC verification coverage, placeholder lexicon, file-impact grounding, AC text hygiene, and testing shape markers can be mechanically validated without semantic judgment, but require unified implementation to avoid duplication.
